summary: Continues magic variables: inventory_hostname_short (affected by delegation), inventory_file, omit (to drop a module option), play_hosts (deprecated), playbook_dir (may differ with import_playbook), role_name, role_names (deprecated), and role_path.
questions: How do I leave out a module parameter when a variable isn't set?
How do I get the short hostname without the domain?
How do I get the directory of the running playbook?
How do I refer to files relative to the current role?
Why does inventory_hostname_short show the delegated host?

answer_card.title: Magic variables (part 4): omit, paths, short names
answer_card.answer_md:
- `inventory_hostname_short`: first part of `inventory_hostname` split on `.` (`www` for `www.example.com`). **Affected by delegation.**
- `inventory_file`: inventory file where the host was first defined (ignores delegation).
- `omit`: drop an option, e.g. `- user: name=bob home={{ bobs_home|default(omit) }}`.
- `play_hosts`: deprecated, same as `ansible_play_batch`.
- `playbook_dir`: directory of the current playbook; may differ from the CLI playbook's directory when `import_playbook` is used.
- `role_name`: name of the running role. `role_path`: its directory.
- `role_names`: deprecated, same as `ansible_play_role_names`.
